title: Snow globes
style: cinematic horror film still, dramatic moody lighting with the subject clearly visible and centered, vintage Christmas in an old house, glowing tree lights and hand-blown glass ornaments, deep red and gold tones with cold blue shadows, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. The twelfth ornament filled in. It was her living room. 🔮

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Holly bought twelve glass ornaments, and was warned to hang eleven and never the twelfth.
scenes.image: eleven glass ornaments hanging on a Christmas tree, an open velvet box beneath it

scenes.narration: She hung eleven. She put the twelfth back in its box, and the box in the hall closet. She could still see the glow under the door.
scenes.image: soft light glowing beneath a closet door in a dark hallway

scenes.narration: In daylight she looked closer at the others. A green sofa. An upright piano. A dog asleep by the fire. Real rooms, she thought. Somebody made these from life.
scenes.image: a glass ornament on a tree branch with a miniature room inside, a tiny upright piano visible

scenes.narration: There were people in them, too. Tiny figures frozen mid-motion. A man reaching for a gift. A woman laughing at something no one will ever hear.
scenes.image: macro shot inside a glass ornament, tiny adult figures frozen beside a miniature Christmas tree

scenes.narration: That night the glow was brighter. Holly opened the closet. She took out the twelfth ornament.
scenes.image: woman in a dark hallway holding a glowing glass ornament in both hands

scenes.narration: It wasn't empty anymore. Inside was a living room. A grey couch, a blanket over the arm. A tree with blue lights. A mug on the coffee table.
scenes.image: inside a glass ornament, a miniature cozy living room with a grey couch and a blue-lit tree

scenes.narration: Her couch. Her tree. Her mug, still half full of the tea she poured an hour ago. Someone had built a perfect little copy of her life.
scenes.image: a real living room with a grey couch, blue-lit tree, and a half full mug on the coffee table

scenes.narration: And there was a figure inside. A tiny woman in a red sweater, standing in a hallway, holding something that glowed.
scenes.image: inside a glass ornament, a miniature woman in a red sweater standing in a dark hallway

scenes.narration: Holly looked down at her own red sweater.
scenes.image: close-up of a woman's red knit sweater, her hands trembling around a glowing ornament

scenes.narration: In the glass, the tiny woman turned her head. Toward her tiny front door. Which was open. And behind Holly, in the real house, cold air came in.
scenes.image: an open front door at night with snow blowing into a dark hallway, Christmas lights behind
